items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: getting back to the, you know, Peter, how them go that, that's Tillman's brother-in-law there.

ctx.x: Yeah, but did the guys sit the one there in the firm? Yeah. Same deal, I understand. Mess around and stuff.

They'd get a weight from one, you know, one dinner. And then it was probably, you know, looking at all, making money in the kind of way they couldn't get it, too. Yeah. And, uh, hey, just, after I left there, I went to the old afternoon, uh, and Willie Fork and D. Eddie Johnson, uh, Mike Gillette was playing trumpet, and John O' Stinkley was playing the piano. I think they had a shorter band or whatever. And they had a big fight. And they were fantastic on it. He was trying to change. But getting back to the, you…
What, what, what, what time was that about?
